title: Evidence commit identity
responsibility: Reads the repository’s configured Git identity and supplies fallback author and committer environment values without changing Git configuration.

inputs.name: commitIdentity.git
inputs.description: Git adapter passed for the repository whose identity is used on evidence and notes commits. The function queries only `git config user.name` and `git config user.email` through it.

outputs.name: commitIdentity
outputs.description: The resolved record contains exactly the four environment keys `GIT_AUTHOR_NAME`, `GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL`, `GIT_COMMITTER_NAME`, and `GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL`. Each name and email uses its configured value, falling back to `Harness` or `harness@localhost` when missing or empty; Git configuration is not changed.

errors.name: git.attempt rejection
errors.description: If either `git.attempt` call throws or rejects, `commitIdentity` rejects with that failure; the function does not catch or translate it, and this implementation specifies no error class.
